titleEn: Vogelsang partners with BeTEC on slurry boom technology
titleZh: Vogelsang与BeTEC成立合资企业，共同开发粪肥施用技术
summaryZh: 德国Vogelsang公司与斯洛文尼亚农机制造商BeTEC建立战略合资企业，共同开发和生产粪肥施用设备。根据协议，BeTEC负责按需生产、设计和技术开发，而Vogelsang保留除斯洛文尼亚外的欧洲销售权。双方将联合推出Vogelsang-BeTEC品牌下的粪肥施用吊杆、滴灌棒和拖靴产品线，其中BlackBird系列将推出RedLine和GreenLine两个新机型，分别定位高端和经济型市场。生产将转移至BeTEC位于斯洛文尼亚Sentjur的工厂。
featuredReason: 该合资企业展示了传统农机企业通过欧洲合作整合产品线、分层定位市场的战略路径，对关注精准施肥装备和粪肥资源化利用的智慧畜牧从业者具有参考价值。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Vogelsang partners with BeTEC on slurry boom technology ![Image 1: Joshua Kelly By Joshua Kelly September 6, 2026 10:00 AM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthorjoshua-kelly) Share this article ![Image 2: Vogelsang has entered a join venture with Slovenian agricultural machinery manufacturer BeTEC Source: Vogelsang](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsvogelsang-partners-with-betec-on-slurry-boom-technology) Vogelsang has entered a join venture with Slovenian agricultural machinery manufacturer BeTEC Source: Vogelsang Vogelsang has entered a "strategic joint venture" to develop slurry applicators with Slovenian agricultural machinery manufacturer BeTEC. As part of the agreement between the two companies, BeTEC will drive forward the needs-based production, design and technical development of the applicators. All European sales activities outside of Slovenia will remain exclusively with Vogelsang within the existing organisational structures. According to Vogelsang, the partnership will combine the German company's "comprehensive expertise in sales and after-sales with BeTEC's effective construction and production processes". Partnership Vogelsang managing director, Harald Vogelsang, spoke about the agreement between his family's company and BeTEC. Harald Vogelsang said: "We are very pleased to shape the future of slurry application technology together with BeTEC and to set new standards in precise slurry application - with modern applicator systems for all customer types and price segments, "As the inventors of dribble bar technology, we are now taking this defining product line of our company to a new level through a European partnership". BeTEC's head of sales, Jure Brecko said: "This joint venture is a milestone in our company's still-young history. "The core beliefs and values of our two family-owned companies align perfectly. These synergies will enable us to grow together," he said. New product ranges range Effective from September 1, the partnership has confirmed the launch of a joint range of slurry application booms, dribble bars and trailing shoes from both companies. These products will be marketed under the brand name 'Vogelsang-BeTEC'. As part of the newly established partnership, manufacturing of all slurry application booms will move to the BeTEC Sentjur site in Slovenia. ![Image 3](https:images.agriland.ieqjHCHCKMJLAa4FDIEMukzgqBbeum3XLjWux8vFcbQiArs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202410Image-3VogelsangBlackBird-Pro15-meters.jpg) Vogelsang's head of sales for agricultural technology and biogas in Germany, Henning Ahlers spoke about the reasoning behind this combination of slurry machinery portfolios. Ahlers said: "Starting immediately, we will be able to offer our customers - from large-scale operations and contract farming businesses to part-time farmers - an even wider range of slurry application technologies, working widths and price segments. "In this initial phase, our focus is on the pan-European market, which we can optimally serve with our combined expertise and our network of subsidiaries and dealer networks." UK and Ireland Agricultural sales lead at Vogelsang, Andy Hayhurst said: "Customers and dealers in the UK will soon benefit from an expanded Vogelsang offering, which will see features from existing Vogelsang and BeTEC products used to offer a comprehensive range of slurry application equipment." The BlackBird series of trailing shoe applicators will be available in two new models, a RedLine and GreenLine, both of which are built on the Vogelsang framework. Hayhurst said: "GreenLine, identifiable by green painted parts, is a more price-focused range that will be supplied with the BeTEC OptiCut distribution technology and standard skids. "The more striking RedLine range will offer an advanced applicator selection that will feature the Vogelsang leaf springs alongside the ExaCut distribution heads and PrecisionFlow skids. "There will also be the option of additional packages including DoubleFlow and NightShift," Hayhurst said. Some existing products inclduing the SwingUp, SwingMax and UniSpread ranges will continue production unchanged. The Umbilical range will be the UniSpread and the BackPack, which is now offered alongside the Stylo, the Hilly, and the Cameleon and Cameleon Light series of machines. According to Hayhurst, a new standardised price list for the joint product range has been drawn up and is available on request from Vogelsang. He confirmed that all enquiries will be managed by the existing sales team in the UK for both dealers and customers. Spare parts sales and servicing for both existing and new machines will be handled by Vogelsang. Vogelsang will be showcasing solutions from its new portfolios at EuroTier, which takes place from November 10-13 in Hanover, Germany. Related Stories Is farming worth it? translationZh:
Vogelsang已与斯洛文尼亚农机制造商BeTEC建立"战略合资企业"，共同开发粪肥施用设备。

作为两家公司协议的一部分，BeTEC将推动施用设备的需求导向型生产、设计和技术开发。除斯洛文尼亚外的所有欧洲销售活动将继续由Vogelsang在现有组织结构内独家负责。

据Vogelsang介绍，此次合作将把这家德国公司在销售和售后服务方面的全面专业知识与BeTEC高效的生产制造工艺相结合。

**合作**

Vogelsang董事总经理Harald Vogelsang谈到了他的家族企业与BeTEC之间的协议。

Harald Vogelsang表示："我们非常高兴能与BeTEC共同塑造粪肥施用技术的未来，并通过适用于所有客户类型和价格区间的现代化施用系统，在精准粪肥施用领域树立新标准。"

"作为滴灌棒技术的发明者，我们正在通过这一欧洲合作伙伴关系，将公司这一标志性产品线提升到新的水平。"

BeTEC销售主管Jure Brecko表示："这家合资企业是我们这家年轻公司历史上的一个里程碑。"

"我们两家家族企业的核心理念和价值观完美契合。这些协同效应将使我们能够共同成长。"

**新产品系列**

自9月1日起生效，该合作已确认推出来自两家公司的联合粪肥施用吊杆、滴灌棒和拖靴产品系列。这些产品将以"Vogelsang-BeTEC"品牌进行销售。

作为新成立合作关系的一部分，所有粪肥施用吊杆的制造将转移至位于斯洛文尼亚Sentjur的BeTEC工厂。

Vogelsang德国农业技术和沼气销售主管Henning Ahlers谈到了整合粪肥机械产品组合背后的考量。

Ahlers表示："从即刻起，我们将能够为客户——从大型经营企业和合同农业企业到兼业农户——提供更广泛的粪肥施用技术、作业宽度和价格区间选择。"

"在初始阶段，我们的重点是泛欧洲市场，我们可以通过联合专业能力以及子公司和经销商网络来最优地服务这一市场。"

**英国和爱尔兰**

Vogelsang农业销售主管Andy Hayhurst表示："英国客户和经销商将很快受益于扩展后的Vogelsang产品线，现有Vogelsang和BeTEC产品的特色将被整合，以提供全面的粪肥施用设备系列。"

BlackBird系列拖靴式施用器将推出两个新机型——RedLine和GreenLine，两者均基于Vogelsang框架打造。

Hayhurst表示："GreenLine以绿色涂装部件为标识，是更注重价格的产品系列，将配备BeTEC OptiCut分配技术和标准滑靴。"

"更具特色的RedLine系列将提供先进的施用器选择，配备Vogelsang板簧以及ExaCut分配头和PrecisionFlow滑靴。"

"还可选配包括DoubleFlow和NightShift在内的附加套餐。"Hayhurst说。

包括SwingUp、SwingMax和UniSpread在内的部分现有产品将继续保持不变地生产。脐带式系列将包括UniSpread和BackPack，后者现与Stylo、Hilly以及Cameleon和Cameleon Light系列机器一同提供。

据Hayhurst介绍，联合产品系列的新标准化价格表已经制定，可向Vogelsang索取。他确认，英国经销商和客户的所有咨询将由现有销售团队管理。

现有和新机器的备件销售和维修服务将由Vogelsang负责处理。

Vogelsang将在11月10日至13日于德国汉诺威举办的EuroTier展会上展示其新产品组合中的解决方案。
